<style>
/* Tema único, nas cores da marca Ótica de Todos */
:root{
  color-scheme:light;
  --teal:#56C6D1;
  --teal-deep:#1E8C98;
  --teal-ink:#0F3F46;
  --red:#EA1D24;
  --red-soft:#FDE8E8;
  --paper:#F2FAFB;
  --white:#FFFFFF;
  --line:#CFE9EC;
  --muted:#4F6F74;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{min-height:100%}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--teal-ink);font-family:'Nunito Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.wrap{max-width:440px;margin:0 auto;padding-inline:16px;padding-block:0 40px}

/* Cabeçalho com a logo */
.brand{background:var(--teal);margin-inline:-16px;padding:22px 16px 56px;display:flex;justify-content:center;border-radius:0 0 28px 28px}
.brand img{width:min(300px,86%);height:auto;display:block}

.screen{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.screen[hidden]{display:none!important}

.card{background:var(--white);border-radius:22px;padding:22px 18px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(15,63,70,.10)}
.lift{margin-top:-40px}

h1{font-family:'Baloo 2','Nunito Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:2rem;line-height:1.05;text-align:center;text-wrap:balance;color:var(--teal-ink)}
h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--red)}
.sub{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.55;margin-top:8px;text-wrap:balance}

.label{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-deep)}

.prize-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--paper);font-weight:700;font-size:.88rem}
.dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0}

.rules{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;margin-top:10px;font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted)}
.rules li{padding-left:18px;position:relative}
.rules li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:4px;top:.55em;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal)}

.btn{width:100%;border:0;cursor:pointer;border-radius:16px;padding:17px 18px;background:var(--red);color:var(--white);font-family:'Baloo 2','Nunito Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:1.2rem;letter-spacing:.01em;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #B3141A;transition:transform .12s,box-shadow .12s}
.btn:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #B3141A}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
.btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal-ink);outline-offset:3px}

/* Roleta */
.wheel-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.pips{display:flex;gap:6px}
.pip{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--teal);background:transparent;transition:background .3s}
.pip.done{background:var(--teal)}
.spins-left{font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--teal-deep);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.wheel-wrap{position:relative;width:min(310px,100%);aspect-ratio:1;margin:6px auto 0;max-width:100%}
#wheel{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.pointer{position:absolute;top:-4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:0;height:0;border-left:14px solid transparent;border-right:14px solid transparent;border-top:28px solid var(--red);filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25));z-index:2}
.toast{min-height:54px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--paper);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);transition:background .3s,color .3s}
.toast.win{background:#E3F6F8;color:var(--teal-ink)}
.won{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;min-height:34px;margin-top:8px}
.won .chip{background:var(--red-soft);color:var(--teal-ink);animation:pop .4s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)}
.total{margin-top:10px;font-weight:800;font-size:.95rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.total span{color:var(--red)}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.5);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}

/* Voucher */
.voucher{background:var(--white);border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(15,63,70,.12)}
.v-head{background:var(--teal);padding:14px 18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.v-head img{height:22px;width:auto}
.v-tag{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--teal-ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
.v-body{padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.v-name{font-family:'Baloo 2',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem}
.v-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.v-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--paper);font-weight:700}
.v-row b{color:var(--red);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.v-row.discount{background:var(--red-soft)}
.v-cut{border:0;border-top:2px dashed var(--line);margin:0 -18px}
.code{display:block;text-align:center;font-family:ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-weight:800;font-size:1.45rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--teal-ink);background:var(--paper);border:2px dashed var(--teal);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;user-select:all}
.expiry{text-align:center;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.expiry strong{color:var(--teal-ink)}
.partner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.partner span{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.partner img{height:40px;width:auto}
.partner.sm img{height:30px}
.hint{text-align:center;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);text-wrap:balance}

#confetti{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:50}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.won .chip{animation:none}}
</style>

<div class="wrap">
  <header class="brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Ótica de Todos"></header>

  <!-- INTRO -->
  <section id="s-intro" class="screen">
    <div class="card lift">
      <h1 id="intro-title">Você ganhou <em>3 giros</em> na roleta! 🎉</h1>
      <p class="sub" id="intro-sub">Gire, junte os prêmios e use na compra do seu óculos na Ótica de Todos.</p>
      <hr class="v-cut" style="margin:18px -18px 14px">
      <div class="partner"><span>Em parceria com</span><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Cartão de Todos"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="label">🎁 Prêmios da roleta</div>
      <div class="prize-list" id="prize-list"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="label">📋 Como funciona</div>
      <ul class="rules">
        <li>São 3 giros. Cada giro dá um prêmio.</li>
        <li>Prêmios válidos na compra de óculos completo (armação + lentes) na Ótica de Todos.</li>
        <li>📅 Válido até <strong class="validade"></strong>.</li>

  <!-- ROLETA -->
  <section id="s-wheel" class="screen" hidden>
    <div class="card lift">
      <div class="wheel-top">
        <div class="pips"><span class="pip" id="pip-0"></span><span class="pip" id="pip-1"></span><span class="pip" id="pip-2"></span></div>
        <span class="spins-left" id="spins-left">3 giros</span>
      </div>
      <div class="wheel-wrap">
        <div class="pointer"></div>
        <canvas id="wheel" width="620" height="620" aria-label="Roleta de prêmios"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div class="partner sm" style="margin-top:12px"><span>Em parceria com</span><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Cartão de Todos"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="toast" id="toast" aria-live="polite">Toque em girar e boa sorte! 🍀</div>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-spin" type="button">🎡 Girar</button>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="label">🏆 Seus prêmios</div>
      <div class="won" id="won"></div>
      <div class="total" id="total" hidden>Desconto acumulado: <span id="total-val">0%</span></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- VOUCHER -->
  <section id="s-voucher" class="screen" hidden>
    <div class="card lift">
      <h1>Seu voucher <em>está pronto!</em> 🎟️</h1>
      <p class="sub">📸 Tire um print desta tela e apresente na loja.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="voucher">
      <div class="v-head"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Ótica de Todos"><span class="v-tag">GIRE &amp; GANHE</span></div>
      <div class="v-body">
        <div class="v-name" id="v-name" hidden></div>
        <div class="v-rows" id="v-rows"></div>
        <hr class="v-cut">
        <div>
          <span class="code" id="v-code">OTD-0000-0000</span>
          <p class="expiry">Válido até <strong id="v-expiry"></strong></p>
        </div>
        <ul class="rules">
          <li>Prêmios válidos na compra de óculos completo (armação + lentes) na Ótica de Todos.</li>
        </ul>
        <hr class="v-cut">
        <div class="partner sm"><span>Em parceria com</span><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Cartão de Todos"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="hint">📍 A equipe confere o código no balcão antes de aplicar os prêmios.</p>
  </section>

  <!-- CONFERÊNCIA (uso da loja: link terminado em #conferir) -->
  <section id="s-check" class="screen" hidden>
    <div class="card lift">
      <h1>Conferir <em>voucher</em></h1>
      <p class="sub">Digite o código que o cliente mostrou.</p>
    </div>
    <form class="card" id="check-form" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px">
      <label class="label" for="check-input">Código do voucher</label>
      <input id="check-input" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="characters" placeholder="OTD-XXXX-XXXX" style="font:800 1.3rem ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:12px;border:2px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;color:var(--teal-ink);background:var(--paper);width:100%">
      <button class="btn" type="submit">Conferir</button>
    </form>
    <div class="card" id="check-result" hidden></div>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
// ── PRÊMIOS ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// weight = chance em cada giro (soma 100). type: 'disc' = desconto, 'gift' = brinde/serviço
const SEGS = [
  { label:'20% OFF',    name:'20% OFF', emoji:'⭐',  type:'disc', pct:20, weight:2,  fill:'#EA1D24', text:'#FFFFFF' },
  { label:'5% OFF',     name:'5% OFF', emoji:'🏷️',   type:'disc', pct:5,  weight:14, fill:'#56C6D1', text:'#0F3F46' },
  { label:'BRINDE\nSURPRESA', name:'Brinde surpresa', emoji:'🎁', type:'gift', bit:1, weight:18, fill:'#FFFFFF', text:'#0F3F46' },
  { label:'10% OFF',    name:'10% OFF', emoji:'💸',  type:'disc', pct:10, weight:12, fill:'#1E8C98', text:'#FFFFFF' },
  { label:'AJUSTE\nGRÁTIS', name:'Ajuste grátis', emoji:'🔧', type:'gift', bit:2, weight:17, fill:'#0F3F46', text:'#FFFFFF' },
  { label:'5% OFF',     name:'5% OFF', emoji:'🏷️',   type:'disc', pct:5,  weight:14, fill:'#56C6D1', text:'#0F3F46' },
  { label:'15% OFF',    name:'15% OFF', emoji:'🔥',  type:'disc', pct:15, weight:5,  fill:'#EA1D24', text:'#FFFFFF' },
  { label:'LIMPEZA\nGRÁTIS', name:'Limpeza grátis', emoji:'✨', type:'gift', bit:4, weight:18, fill:'#FFFFFF', text:'#0F3F46' },
];
const MAX_DISC = 20;
const GIFT_EMOJI = { 1:'🎁', 2:'🔧', 4:'✨' };
const GIFT_NAMES = { 1:'Brinde surpresa', 2:'Ajuste grátis', 4:'Limpeza grátis' };
const STORE_KEY = 'otd-roleta-v2';
const VALIDADE = new Date('2026-09-30T23:59:59-03:00'); // fim da campanha
const VALIDADE_TXT = VALIDADE.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { timeZone:'America/Sao_Paulo' });
document.querySelectorAll('.validade').forEach(el => el.textContent = VALIDADE_TXT);

let rot = 0, spinning = false, used = 0;
let disc = 0, giftMask = 0, won = [];
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);

// ── LISTA DE PRÊMIOS NA INTRO ───────────────────────────
(function listPrizes(){
  const seen = new Set();
  const items = [...SEGS].sort((a,b)=> (b.type==='disc')-(a.type==='disc') || (b.pct||0)-(a.pct||0));
  $('prize-list').innerHTML = items.filter(s=>!seen.has(s.name)&&seen.add(s.name)).map(s=>{
    const c = s.fill==='#FFFFFF' ? '#56C6D1' : s.fill;
    return `<div class="chip"><span aria-hidden="true">${s.emoji}</span>${s.name}</div>`;
  }).join('');
})();

// ── DESENHO DA ROLETA ───────────────────────────────────
const cv = $('wheel'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
const hub = new Image(); hub.src = 'data:image/png;base64,'; hub.onload = () => draw(rot);
function draw(r){
  const W = cv.width, c = W/2, R = c - 14, n = SEGS.length, a = Math.PI*2/n;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,W);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c,c,R+10,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle='#0F3F46'; ctx.fill();
  SEGS.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const st = r + i*a, md = st + a/2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(c,c); ctx.arc(c,c,R,st,st+a); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle = s.fill; ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0F3F46'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(c,c); ctx.rotate(md);
    ctx.fillStyle = s.text; ctx.textAlign='right'; ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    const lines = s.label.split('\n');
    if (lines.length === 1){ ctx.font = '800 32px "Baloo 2", sans-serif'; ctx.fillText(lines[0], R-20, 2); }
    else { ctx.font = '800 22px "Nunito Sans", sans-serif'; lines.forEach((l,k)=>ctx.fillText(l, R-22, (k-.5)*24+2)); }
    ctx.font = '24px "Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign='center'; ctx.fillText(s.emoji, 90, 2);
    ctx.restore();
  });
  // lâmpadas no aro
  for(let k=0;k<24;k++){ const t=k/24*Math.PI*2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c+(R+5)*Math.cos(t), c+(R+5)*Math.sin(t), 3.5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle = k%2 ? '#FFFFFF' : '#56C6D1'; ctx.fill(); }
  // centro com o símbolo da marca
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c,c,62,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fillStyle='#56C6D1'; ctx.fill(); ctx.lineWidth=6; ctx.strokeStyle='#FFFFFF'; ctx.stroke();
  if (hub.complete && hub.naturalWidth){ ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c,c,58,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.clip(); ctx.drawImage(hub, c-44, c-44, 88, 88); ctx.restore(); }
}
document.fonts && document.fonts.ready.then(()=>draw(rot));

// ── SORTEIO (chance real, com as regras de limite) ──────
function eligible(i){
  const s = SEGS[i];
  if (s.type==='disc') return disc + s.pct <= MAX_DISC; // só sorteia desconto que cabe no limite
  return !(giftMask & s.bit);
}
function pick(){
  const pool = SEGS.map((s,i)=>i).filter(eligible);
  const total = pool.reduce((t,i)=>t+SEGS[i].weight,0);
  let x = Math.random()*total;
  for (const i of pool){ x -= SEGS[i].weight; if (x < 0) return i; }
  return pool[pool.length-1];
}
function targetRot(i){
  const a = Math.PI*2/SEGS.length;
  const off = .2 + Math.random()*.6;
  const base = -Math.PI/2 - (i+off)*a;
  const min = rot + (5 + Math.random()*2)*Math.PI*2;
  return base + Math.ceil((min-base)/(Math.PI*2))*Math.PI*2;
}
const ease = t => 1 - Math.pow(1-t, 3.5);

function spin(){
  if (spinning || used >= 3) return;
  spinning = true; $('btn-spin').disabled = true;
  $('toast').className='toast'; $('toast').textContent='🎡 Girando...';
  const i = pick(), from = rot, to = targetRot(i);
  const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const dur = reduce ? 600 : 4000 + Math.random()*600, t0 = performance.now();
  (function step(now){
    const p = Math.min((now-t0)/dur,1);
    rot = from + (to-from)*ease(p); draw(rot);
    p < 1 ? requestAnimationFrame(step) : land(i);
  })(t0);
}

function land(i){
  spinning = false; used++;
  $('pip-'+(used-1)).classList.add('done');
  const s = SEGS[i];
  let msg;
  if (s.type==='disc'){
    disc += s.pct; msg = `🎉 Você ganhou ${s.emoji} ${s.name}!`;
    $('total').hidden = false; $('total-val').textContent = disc + '%';
  } else {
    giftMask |= s.bit; msg = `🎉 Você ganhou ${s.emoji} ${s.name}!`;
  }
  won.push(s);
  const chip = document.createElement('div'); chip.className='chip'; chip.textContent = `${s.emoji} ${s.name}`; $('won').appendChild(chip);
  $('toast').className='toast win'; $('toast').textContent = msg;
  const left = 3 - used;
  $('spins-left').textContent = left ? `${left} giro${left>1?'s':''}` : 'Giros usados';
  const b = $('btn-spin');
  if (left){ b.disabled = false; b.textContent = left===1 ? '🔥 Último giro' : '🍀 Girar de novo'; }
  else { b.disabled = false; b.textContent = '🎟️ Ver meu voucher'; b.onclick = finish; setTimeout(finish, 1800); }
}

// ── CÓDIGO DO VOUCHER (com verificação) ─────────────────
// 40 bits: desconto (3) | brindes (3) | nº do cliente (18) | aleatório (4) | verificação (12)
const ALPH = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
function check(d,m,id,n){ let h = 2166136261; for (const ch of `${d}.${m}.${id}.${n}.otd-roleta`){ h ^= ch.charCodeAt(0); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) >>> 0; } return h % 4096; }
function makeCode(d,m,id){
  const n = Math.floor(Math.random()*16);
  let v = ((((d/5)*8 + m) * 262144 + id) * 16 + n) * 4096 + check(d/5,m,id,n);
  let s = ''; for (let k=0;k<8;k++){ s = ALPH[v % 32] + s; v = Math.floor(v/32); }
  return `OTD-${s.slice(0,4)}-${s.slice(4)}`;
}
function readCode(code){
  const s = String(code).toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,'').replace(/^OTD/,'');
  if (s.length !== 8) return null;
  let v = 0; for (const ch of s){ const k = ALPH.indexOf(ch); if (k < 0) return null; v = v*32 + k; }
  const chk = v % 4096; v = Math.floor(v/4096);
  const n = v % 16; v = Math.floor(v/16);
  const id = v % 262144; v = Math.floor(v/262144);
  const m = v % 8, d = Math.floor(v/8);
  if (d > 4 || check(d,m,id,n) !== chk) return null;
  return { disc: d*5, giftMask: m, id };
}

function finish(){
  if (!$('s-voucher').hidden) return;
  const code = makeCode(disc, giftMask, LINK.id);
  const data = { code, disc, giftMask, exp: VALIDADE.toISOString(), nome: LINK.nome };
  try { localStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY + '-' + LINK.id, JSON.stringify(data)); } catch(e){}
  showVoucher(data); confetti();
}

function showVoucher(d){
  $('s-intro').hidden = true; $('s-wheel').hidden = true; $('s-voucher').hidden = false;
  const rows = [];
  if (d.disc) rows.push(`<div class="v-row discount"><span>👓 Desconto no óculos</span><b>${d.disc}% OFF</b></div>`);
  [1,2,4].forEach(bit => { if (d.giftMask & bit) rows.push(`<div class="v-row"><span>${GIFT_EMOJI[bit]} ${GIFT_NAMES[bit]}</span><b>Grátis</b></div>`); });
  $('v-rows').innerHTML = rows.join('');
  $('v-code').textContent = d.code;
  $('v-expiry').textContent = VALIDADE_TXT;
  if (d.nome){ $('v-name').hidden = false; $('v-name').textContent = d.nome; }
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
}

// ── CONFETE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function confetti(){
  if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
  const c = $('confetti'), x = c.getContext('2d'); c.width = innerWidth; c.height = innerHeight;
  const cols = ['#56C6D1','#EA1D24','#FFFFFF','#1E8C98'];
  const ps = Array.from({length:110},()=>({x:Math.random()*c.width,y:-10-Math.random()*80,w:6+Math.random()*6,h:8+Math.random()*8,c:cols[Math.random()*4|0],vx:-2+Math.random()*4,vy:3+Math.random()*4,r:Math.random()*360,s:-5+Math.random()*10,o:1}));
  let f = 0;
  (function d(){
    x.clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
    ps.forEach(p=>{ p.x+=p.vx; p.y+=p.vy; p.vy+=.06; p.r+=p.s; if(p.y>c.height*.7)p.o-=.03;
      x.save(); x.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.o); x.translate(p.x,p.y); x.rotate(p.r*Math.PI/180); x.fillStyle=p.c; x.strokeStyle='rgba(15,63,70,.25)'; x.fillRect(-p.w/2,-p.h/2,p.w,p.h); x.strokeRect(-p.w/2,-p.h/2,p.w,p.h); x.restore(); });
    if (++f < 170) requestAnimationFrame(d); else x.clearRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);
  })();
}

// ── LINK INDIVIDUAL (#c37.<nome em base64url>) ───────────
function readLink(){
  const h = (location.hash || '').slice(1);
  const m = h.match(/^c(\d{1,6})(?:\.([A-Za-z0-9_-]+))?$/);
  if (!m) return { id: 0, nome: '' };
  let nome = '';
  try {
    let b = m[2] || ''; b = b.replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/'); while (b.length % 4) b += '=';
    nome = b ? new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(b), c => c.charCodeAt(0))).trim() : '';
  } catch(e){ nome = ''; }
  return { id: Math.min(+m[1], 262143), nome };
}
const LINK = readLink();

function runCheck(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const r = readCode($('check-input').value), box = $('check-result');
  box.hidden = false;
  if (!r){ box.innerHTML = '<div class="v-row" style="background:var(--red-soft)"><span>Código inválido</span><b>Não aplicar</b></div><p class="sub" style="text-align:left">Confira se foi digitado certo. Se continuar inválido, o voucher não é da roleta.</p>'; return; }
  const rows = [`<div class="v-row"><span>Nº do cliente</span><b>${r.id ? r.id : 'Link geral'}</b></div>`];
  if (r.disc) rows.push(`<div class="v-row discount"><span>Desconto no óculos</span><b>${r.disc}% OFF</b></div>`);
  [1,2,4].forEach(bit => { if (r.giftMask & bit) rows.push(`<div class="v-row"><span>${bit===1 ? 'Brinde surpresa: entregar limpa-lentes' : GIFT_NAMES[bit]}</span><b>Brinde</b></div>`); });
  const vencido = Date.now() > VALIDADE.getTime();
  rows.push(`<div class="v-row"><span>Validade</span><b>${vencido ? 'Vencido em ' : 'Até '}${VALIDADE_TXT}</b></div>`);
  box.innerHTML = '<div class="label">Código válido</div><div class="v-rows" style="margin-top:10px">' + rows.join('') + '</div><p class="sub" style="text-align:left;margin-top:10px">Procure o nº do cliente na planilha e marque como usado.</p>';
}

// ── INÍCIO ──────────────────────────────────────────────
(function init(){
  if ((location.hash || '').toLowerCase() === '#conferir'){
    $('s-intro').hidden = true; $('s-check').hidden = false;
    $('check-form').addEventListener('submit', runCheck);
    return;
  }
  const nome = LINK.nome.split(/\s+/)[0];
  if (nome){
    $('intro-title').innerHTML = '';
    $('intro-title').append(nome + ', você ganhou ');
    const em = document.createElement('em'); em.textContent = '3 giros'; $('intro-title').append(em, ' na roleta! 🎉');
  }
  let saved = null;
  try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY + '-' + LINK.id) || 'null'); } catch(e){}
  if (saved && saved.code){ showVoucher(saved); return; }
  if (Date.now() > VALIDADE.getTime()){
    $('intro-title').innerHTML = 'Esta promoção <em>foi encerrada</em>';
    $('intro-sub').textContent = 'Fique de olho nas próximas campanhas da Ótica de Todos.';
    $('btn-start').disabled = true; $('btn-start').textContent = 'Promoção encerrada';
    return;
  }
  $('btn-start').onclick = () => { $('s-intro').hidden = true; $('s-wheel').hidden = false; draw(rot); window.scrollTo(0,0); };
  $('btn-spin').onclick = spin;
  draw(rot);
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
